card.name: Start of a name after an opening parenthesis
card.fires_on: The letter S that begins a name (Sinequan, Sorrell, sodium, Suddeath), often right after an opening parenthesis. Also fires on a few other break points such as 'which' after a comma and the ')' in a numbered list.

modes.label: S starting a name
modes.description: A lone S or s begins a brand, case or salt name, usually just after a bracket.

modes.label: Parenthesis in numbered list
modes.description: The closing bracket of '1)' that opens a list of management steps.
modes.example: The management of NMS should include 1<<)>> immediate discontinuation of antipsychotic

modes.label: Which after a comma
modes.description: The word 'which' that opens a clause following a comma.
modes.example: increased rate of cervical dilation,<< which>> tends to shorten labor.

card.plain: It fires when a name begins with a separate letter S, often right after a bracket, so the rest of the name follows.
